evidence.source: pret/pokefirered@ce6406d8 data/maps/VictoryRoad_3F/scripts.inc: VictoryRoad_3F_OnLoad calls the SetRockBarrier script (`setmetatile` RockBarrier_Top, collision 1: this gate's tiles close) while VAR_MAP_SCENE_VICTORY_ROAD_3F is not 100; the coord event at (7, 7) runs VictoryRoad_3F_EventScript_FloorSwitch*, which redraws the barrier open (Floor_Ledge_Top, collision 0), plays SE_ICE_BREAK, copies the boulders' positions to their permanent ones and sets VAR_MAP_SCENE_VICTORY_ROAD_3F to 100 (an already-pressed switch does nothing). Route23_OnTransition (data/maps/Route23/scripts.inc) sets it back to 0 on every entry to Route 23, so the barrier closes again
evidence.pressed_by: push a Strength boulder onto the button tile (7, 7): src/field_player_avatar.c DoBoulderFinish calls HandleBoulderActivateVictoryRoadSwitch (src/field_control_avatar.c), which runs the coord event script of that tile when its metatile behavior is MB_STRENGTH_BUTTON. The player stepping on the tile does nothing: the event's var_value is 99 and the var is 0
evidence.reset: closed again after Route 23 loads; a consumer clears this var on entering Route 23
